# ferriskey_webhook (Resource)

Manages a webhook subscription within a FerrisKey realm. The signing secret is never returned by the API except when it is rotated, so `secret` is only populated after setting or changing `rotate_secret_trigger`. Delivery history and retries are not managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_webhook" "audit" {
  realm       = "acme"
  name        = "audit"
  endpoint    = "https://hooks.example.com/ferriskey"
  subscribers = ["user.created", "user.deleted"]

  headers = {
    "X-Token" = "s3cret"
  }

  retry_policy = {
    max_attempts = 5
  }

  rotate_secret_trigger = "2024-01"
}

output "audit_webhook_secret" {
  value     = ferriskey_webhook.audit.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) URL that receives the webhook deliveries.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the webhook belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `subscribers` (Set of String) Set of event triggers the webhook subscribes to, e.g. `user.created`, `client.updated`, `realm.settings.updated`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Webhook description.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Extra HTTP headers sent with every delivery. The API never returns them, so the value is tracked from configuration only and drift cannot be detected. Removing the attribute clears the stored headers.
- `name` (String) Human-readable webhook name.
- `retry_policy` (Attributes) Per-webhook retry policy overriding the realm defaults. Unset fields fall back to the realm settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retry_policy))
- `rotate_secret_trigger` (String) Arbitrary value; setting it on creation or changing it afterwards rotates the signing secret in place (the webhook is not replaced) and refreshes `secret`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{webhook_id}`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret returned by the last rotation. Null until `rotate_secret_trigger` has been set.
- `webhook_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the webhook.

<a id="nestedatt--retry_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retry_policy`

Optional:

- `base_delay_ms` (Number) Initial retry delay in milliseconds.
- `max_attempts` (Number) Maximum number of delivery attempts.
- `max_delay_ms` (Number) Upper bound for a single retry delay in milliseconds.
- `max_total_delay_ms` (Number) Upper bound for the cumulative retry delay in milliseconds.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_webhook.audit acme/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
